bis-scheme-one-marks.quote: For products covered under Scheme- I- ISI Mark and Eco Mark

bis-quality-complaint.quote: Quality of BIS Certified Products including products under Compulsory Registration Scheme and Hallmarking Scheme.

bis-complaint-channels.quote: Complaint can be made both offline and online through post, email, mobile app or BIS Standard Promotion Portal .

sabzi-low-cost-postharvest.quote: simple, low cost technologies often can be more appropriate for small volume, limited resource commercial operations

sabzi-packing-chot.quote: packing methods and packaging materials that can help to maintain product quality and reduce mechanical damage during handling, transport and storage

enam-farmer-app-register.quote: After downloading the app choose register in the Home Page options and follow the steps.

enam-my-lots-history.quote: In My Lots History Farmer can view past 7 days of his lots information.

enam-auction-accept-reject.quote: Once the auction is completed and the winner is declared, farmer can either choose to accept it or reject it.

enam-trader-registration-ways.quote: Through e-NAM Portal- http://www.enam.gov.in - Through Mobile Application - Through Mandi Registration (by physically visiting a mandi)

enam-trader-registration-fee.quote: There is no fee for registration on e-NAM. Required Documents and details for registration : - Basic mandatory details like Name, Sex, Address, DOB, Mobile Number, Bank details etc.

enam-transparent-bidding.quote: Trading could be done electronically through a transparent bidding process.

kusum-three-components.quote: Component-A: Setting up of 10,000 MW of Decentralized Ground/ Stilt Mounted Grid-Connected Solar or other Renewable Energy based Power Plants.
Component-B: Installation of 14 Lakh Stand-alone Solar Agriculture Pumps.
Component-C: Solarisation of 35 Lakh Grid Connected Agriculture Pumps including Feeder Level Solarization.

kusum-offgrid-pump.quote: Individual farmers will be supported to install standalone solar Agriculture pumps of capacity up to 7.5 HP in off-grid areas, where grid supply is not available.

kusum-component-b-share.quote: CFA of 30% of the benchmark cost or the tender cast, whichever is lower, of the stand-alone solar Agriculture pump will be provided.
The State Government will give at least a subsidy of 30%; and the remaining at-most 40% will be provided by the farmer.

kcc-timely-flexible-credit.quote: The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998 to provide farmers with timely and flexible credit for purchase of agricultural inputs and production needs.

kcc-crop-allied-limit.quote: The scheme now covers short-term loans for crop cultivation as well as working capital requirement for allied activities such as animal husbandry, dairy, fisheries bee keeping etc,
subject to the prescribed limit of Rs.3 Lakh with a sub limit of Rs.2 Lakh for allied activities.

kcc-warehouse-receipt-credit.quote: small and marginal farmers having KCC are eligible for concessional credit for a further period of up to six months post-harvest, against e-NWRs issued for produce stored in warehouses accredited by the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA).

nabard-production-credit.quote: The system has features like assessment of credit needs, provision of credit for purchase of inputs like fertilizers, pesticides etc.

nabard-credit-drawal-period.quote: Each drawal against the sanctioned credit limit is repayable within 12 months.

nabard-calamity-conversion.quote: Refinance facility is available to StCBs and RRBs against the loans converted/ rescheduled / rephased of farmers affected by natural calamities

soil-health-card-languages.quote: It facilitates generation of Soil Health Cards (SHC) in 22 different languages, 5 dialects and in local units

soil-health-card-recommendations.quote: A SHC provides the farmer with the nutrient status of his land and gives recommendations on the dosage of fertilizers, bio-fertilizers, organic fertilizers as well as soil amendments

soil-health-card-workflow.quote: Workflow Sample Collection Farmers/ Village Level Agencies Mobile Soil Testing Laboratories Sample Registration Block/District Level Officers CSCS Testing Soil Testing Laboratories Automatic Fertiliser Recommendation
